concept.hr: Jedan zajednički kanal: osluškivanje, digipeateri i put WIDEn-N
concept.en: One shared channel: carrier sense, digipeaters and WIDEn-N path aliases

summary.hr: Svjetionik kroz digipeatere odsječak po odsječak: WIDE1-1 i WIDEn-N, umetnuti pozivni znakovi, duplikati, sudari i skrivene stanice koje CSMA ne spašava.
summary.en: A beacon through digipeaters slot by slot: WIDE1-1 and WIDEn-N, inserted call signs, duplicates, collisions and hidden stations that CSMA cannot save.

what.hr: Opis APRS-a na 144,800 MHz (AFSK preko FM-a, 1200 bit/s) i digipeatera (tekst, sažeto i prerađeno; 50ohm.de, odjeljci afsk i relaisfunkstellen)
what.en: The description of APRS on 144.800 MHz (AFSK over FM, 1200 bit/s) and of digipeaters (text, summarised and adapted; 50ohm.de, sections afsk and relaisfunkstellen)

changes.hr: Odjeljci afsk i relaisfunkstellen (hrvatski prijevod) sažeti u opis i objašnjenje; pravila puta, duplikata i CSMA-a, rasporedi i brojevi su dodani; ništa nije preuzeto doslovno
changes.en: The sections afsk and relaisfunkstellen (Croatian translation) summarised into the description and the explanation; the path, duplicate and CSMA rules, the layouts and the numbers are added; nothing is copied verbatim
